_note: This file lives in the thaumaturge namespace on purpose: NeoForge derives a data map type's id from the folder namespace plus the file name, so a copy under data/thaumicenergistics_ce/ would be rejected as a non-existent type 'thaumicenergistics_ce:base_aspects'. Several packs may provide this path; the loader stacks and merges them, and Thaumaturge's own copy sets no replace flag, so this entry adds to it. The ME controller is unscannable without it: Thaumaturge derives item aspects from crafting recipes, but the controller's three inputs (smooth sky stone, fluix crystal, engineering processor) are all made outside a crafting grid, so nothing derives and the index holds no entry for it.
